name: Adaptify SEO One-Click Publishing
author: hansjan

sections.description:
Adaptify SEO One-Click Publishing automates your SEO process, allowing you to rank higher on Google while you focus on your core business.

How does Adaptify SEO work?

  • Website Analysis: Adaptify analyzes your WordPress site to understand your business and customer profile.
  • SEO Strategy Creation: It develops an SEO strategy with relevant keyword clusters tailored to your niche.
  • Automated Execution: Adaptify automatically creates high-ranking content and publishes it directly to your WordPress site.
  • Optimization for Search Intent: The content is optimized to address search intent, ensuring excellent Google rankings.

AI-Powered Customization

Adaptify uses advanced AI to gain deep insights into your business, crafting highly customized content that drives both traffic and conversions. Articles are interlinked automatically for optimal SEO.

Supported SEO Plugins

This plugin works seamlessly with:

  • Yoast SEO
  • RankMath
  • All in One SEO (AIOSEO)
  • SEOPress

Features

  • One-click publishing from Adaptify dashboard
  • Automatic SEO metadata synchronization
  • Featured image handling with alt text
  • Category and tag assignment
  • Custom author support
  • Schema markup support
  • Fallback publishing via WP-Cron (handles rate limits automatically)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ada-seo-by-adaptify directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > SEO One-Click Publishing to configure the plugin.
  4. Click “Create New Application Password” to connect with Adaptify.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Adaptify account?

Yes, this plugin connects your WordPress site to the Adaptify SEO platform. Visit adaptify.ai to create an account.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

The plugin works with Yoast SEO, RankMath, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), and SEOPress. If you don’t have any SEO plugin installed, basic meta fields will still be set.

What happens if publishing fails?

The plugin includes automatic fallback publishing. If the standard REST API method fails (due to rate limits, firewall issues, etc.), articles are automatically queued and published via WP-Cron within 15 minutes.
